reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, wide-packet re-review batch 3, 2026-08-01

samples_reviewed.question_text: An object measures 21 cm. About how many cm is that, rounded to the nearest 10?
An object measures 2 cm. About how many cm is that, rounded to the nearest 10?
An object measures 14 cm. About how many cm is that, rounded to the nearest 10?
An object measures 9 cm. About how many cm is that, rounded to the nearest 10?
An object measures 3 cm. About how many cm is that, rounded to the nearest 10?
An object measures 16 cm. About how many cm is that, rounded to the nearest 10?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: 'An object measures 14 cm. About how many cm is that, rounded to the nearest 10?' answering 10 is a reasonable proxy for estimation, but 'estimate ... distance using meters' is never attempted in any of the 6 samples.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: All 6 samples round a centimeter value to the nearest 10; meters and distance, both explicitly named in 'Estimate length using meters or centimeters, and distance using meters', are absent from every seed.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Rounding small two-digit values (2, 3, 9, 14, 16, 21) to the nearest 10 is an appropriately light reasoning step for Grade 2 Quarter 2.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: mcq and cloze formatters both appear, but the underlying task 'An object measures X cm. About how many cm is that, rounded to the nearest 10?' is identical wording in every one of the 6 seeds, leaving no distance-estimation or meter-scale variant.

competency_alignment.rationale: The variation across seeds (2, 3, 9, 14, 16, 21 cm) only drills the rounding-to-nearest-10 mechanic, not the unit-scale judgment ('would this be closer to 1 m or 50 cm?') implied by 'estimate ... using meters or centimeters'.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Every value stays under 25 cm across all 6 seeds; the competency's meter-scale estimation ceiling is never touched, so students never practice estimating anything at the meter range the wording calls for.
